advice.thin: Faida ndogo — biashara hii ina hatari
advice.reasonable: Faida ya kuridhisha — angalia hatari hizi
advice.breakEvenClose: Bei yako ya kufikia usawa iko karibu na bei ya chini ya soko
advice.lossBody: Your projected costs ({cost}) exceed your projected revenue ({revenue}). Before committing funds, review costs, yield and the market price.
advice.thinBody: An ROI of {roi}% is low for agriculture. A drop in price or yield could remove your profit; reduce costs and secure better buyers.
advice.reasonableBody: An ROI of {roi}% is a solid return if your inputs and selling price hold. Monitor seasonal prices and input-cost inflation.
advice.strongBody: An ROI of {roi}% is excellent. Confirm the result at a manageable scale, secure buyers and keep detailed cost records.
advice.breakEvenBody: Your break-even selling price is {price}. The reference low-end market price for {commodity} is around {low}. Reduce costs or target premium buyers if prices fall.
advice.tipTomatoBody: Tomato prices are highly seasonal. Consider dry-season production and rapid transport or processing to reduce post-harvest losses.
advice.tipCucumberBody: Stake cucumbers to improve quality and reduce disease. Urban supermarkets, hotels and restaurants can pay a premium.
advice.tipCassavaBody: Value addition can improve cassava returns. Early weed management is essential for protecting yield.
advice.tipMaizeBody: Storage can improve maize returns after harvest. Use safe storage to sell when seasonal stocks are lower.
advice.tipRiceBody: Milling and quality grading can increase rice value. Plan drying and market access before harvest.
advice.tipHabaneroTitle: Ushauri wa kilimo cha pilipili habanero
advice.tipHabaneroBody: Harvest frequently and handle peppers carefully. Secure buyers before peak harvest to manage price swings.
advice.tipBroilerTitle: Ushauri wa ufugaji wa kuku wa nyama
advice.tipBroilerBody: Feed is the main cost. Buy reliable chicks, manage feed closely and plan sales before birds reach market weight.
advice.tipLayerTitle: Ushauri wa ufugaji wa kuku wa mayai
advice.tipLayerBody: Track feed conversion and egg production daily. Stable buyers and good flock health protect margins.
advice.tipFishBody: Control feed waste and water quality. Grade fish regularly and arrange buyers before harvest.
advice.tipPigBody: Feed management and biosecurity are central to pig profitability. Keep strict hygiene and production records.
advice.tipCattleBody: Buy healthy animals and plan sales around strong demand periods. Feed efficiency drives the margin.
advice.tipGoatBody: Time sales for high-demand periods and keep animals healthy. Mature goats can command premium prices.
advice.costControlBody: Kagua gharama kubwa kwanza. Uwekezaji unaokadiriwa sasa ni {cost}. Linganisha mbegu, chakula, mbolea, kazi, umwagiliaji, usafirishaji na hasara baada ya mavuno na bei za eneo lako, kisha punguza gharama zinazoweza kuepukwa bila kupunguza ubora.
advice.marketBody: Usisubiri mavuno ndipo utafute wanunuzi. Angalia bei za sasa, tambua angalau njia mbili za kuuza, thibitisha mahitaji ya ubora na kadiria gharama za usafirishaji na ufungashaji kabla ya kuwekeza.
advice.breakEvenActionTitle: Tumia bei ya usawa kama hatua ya maamuzi
advice.breakEvenActionBody: Bei yako ya usawa iliyokadiriwa ni {price}. Linganisha na bei halisi za eneo lako na jaribu mpango kwa bei au mavuno ya chini kabla ya kupanda.
advice.recordsBody: Rekodi kiasi cha pembejeo, kazi, tarehe, mavuno, bei ya kuuza, hasara na fedha zilizopokelewa. Linganisha matokeo halisi na ripoti ili kuboresha bajeti inayofuata.
advice.returnVisitTitle: Rudi baada ya mzunguko wa uzalishaji
advice.returnVisitBody: Hifadhi ripoti hii na urudi baada ya mavuno kulinganisha gharama, mavuno, bei na faida halisi na makadirio. Ulinganisho huo utakusaidia kuboresha mipango ijayo.

about.title: Maarifa ya kilimo ya vitendo, yanayotokana na utafiti halisi
about.intro: GoOrganicAfrica imejengwa juu ya wazo moja rahisi: maarifa ya kilimo yanapaswa kuwa ya vitendo, yaliyojaribiwa na kupatikana kwa wakulima kote Afrika.
about.whoText: Miongozo na zana za GoOrganicAfrica zimeandaliwa na {author} — mkulima, mtafiti wa kilimo na mtengenezaji wa mbolea hai mwenye cheti cha Kilimo tangu 2001. Kila mwongozo na kila data katika Kikokotoo chetu cha bure hutokana na uzoefu halisi wa uzalishaji na utafiti endelevu, si nadharia pekee.
about.whatText: Mbali na utafiti na uandishi, kazi ya GoOrganicAfrica inahusisha bidhaa kadhaa za kilimo hai:
about.inoc: InoculumPlus — mbolea hai yenye msingi wa Mycorrhiza inayouzwa kwa wakulima Nigeria, Cameroon na Niger
about.organic: OrganicGrow — suluhisho la kilimo hai kwa kuku, samaki na mifugo mingine, lililowafikia wakulima Cameroon na Ivory Coast
about.toolsIntro: Tunatoa rasilimali mbili kuu kwa wakulima wa Afrika:
about.calculator: Kikokotoo cha Bure cha Faida ya Shamba
about.calculatorText: — hesabu gharama za uzalishaji, mapato, faida, ROI na bei ya usawa katika nchi {countries} za Afrika na biashara {enterprises} za kilimo, kwa kubadilisha sarafu kiotomatiki
about.guidesText: — miongozo ya hatua kwa hatua kuhusu hydroponic fodder, ufugaji wa Black Soldier Fly, kilimo cha uyoga wa oyster na muhogo bila palizi
about.missionText: Kusaidia kufanya kilimo Nigeria, Afrika na duniani kuwa na faida zaidi na endelevu — kwa mwongozo na zana moja ya vitendo kwa wakati mmoja. Soma maarifa yetu ya hivi karibuni kwenye blogu ya GoOrganicAfrica.
about.externalText: Kwa wakulima wanaotafuta data na utafiti zaidi wa kilimo, tunapendekeza:
about.fao: FAO (Shirika la Chakula na Kilimo la Umoja wa Mataifa) — takwimu na utafiti wa kilimo duniani
about.iita: IITA (Taasisi ya Kimataifa ya Kilimo cha Kitropiki) — utafiti wa mazao na kilimo unaolenga Afrika

privacy.title: Sera ya Faragha
privacy.whoText: GoOrganicAfrica ni jukwaa la elimu ya kilimo na bidhaa za kidijitali linaloendeshwa na Amoo Oluwatoyin Owolabi nchini Nigeria. Tovuti hii hutoa Kikokotoo cha Bure, miongozo ya kilimo hai na makala kwa wakulima Afrika.
privacy.collect1: Kikokotoo huhifadhi chaguo la nchi ndani ya kivinjari (localStorage). Data hii hubaki kwenye kifaa chako na haitumwi kwenye seva zetu.
privacy.collect2: Ukituwasiliana nasi kupitia Mawasiliano, WhatsApp au barua pepe, tunapokea jina na maelezo yako kwa ajili ya kujibu ombi lako pekee.
privacy.adsText: Tovuti hii inaweza kuonyesha matangazo ya Google AdSense. Google hutumia cookies kulingana na ziara za awali. Unaweza kuzima matangazo yaliyobinafsishwa kupitia mipangilio ya Google.
privacy.externalText: Tovuti hii ina viungo vya Selar na tovuti nyingine. Hatuwajibiki kwa sera za faragha za tovuti za watu wengine.
privacy.cookiesText: Tunatumia cookies za utendaji zinazohitajika kwa tovuti kufanya kazi. Hatutumii cookies za ufuatiliaji zaidi ya zinazowekwa na Google AdSense.
privacy.rightsText: Unaweza kufuta localStorage ya kivinjari chako wakati wowote. Kuomba kufutwa kwa taarifa ulizotupatia moja kwa moja, wasiliana nasi kupitia {email}.
privacy.disclaimerText: Hesabu zote za Kikokotoo ni makadirio tu na si ushauri wa kifedha, uwekezaji au kilimo. Utendaji halisi hutegemea mavuno, bei za pembejeo, hali ya hewa, wadudu, magonjwa, kazi, usafirishaji na soko. Thibitisha bei na gharama za eneo lako kabla ya kuwekeza.
privacy.contactText: Kwa maswali kuhusu faragha, wasiliana nasi kupitia {email} au WhatsApp.

dataUpdates.intro: GoOrganicAfrica imeundwa kusasisha data za rejea za kilimo kutoka serikali, masoko na taasisi husika, huku mabadiliko yasiyo na uhakika yakipitiwa.

organic.title: Kilimo hai cha vitendo kwa Afrika
organic.intro: GoOrganicAfrica inakuza kilimo hai cha vitendo na kinachowajibika barani Afrika kwa kuunganisha uzoefu halisi wa shambani, pembejeo za kibayolojia, afya ya udongo, utunzaji wa mifugo na elimu ya wakulima.
organic.missionTitle: Kutoka shambani hadi kwa wakulima wa Afrika
organic.missionBody: Sehemu hii inaeleza mbinu ya GoOrganicAfrica ya kilimo hai na kutambulisha bidhaa zinazotengenezwa au kutumiwa katika kazi hiyo.
organic.inoculumBody: Mbolea ya kibayolojia yenye msingi wa fangasi wa mycorrhiza inayolenga kusaidia uhusiano wenye manufaa kati ya mizizi ya mimea na fangasi wa udongo. Taarifa za bidhaa, matumizi na uzoefu wa shambani vinaweza kuongezwa hapa.
organic.organicGrowBody: Suluhisho la kilimo hai linalowasilishwa kwa kuku, samaki na mifugo mingine. Wakulima wanaweza kujifunza matumizi yake, namna ya kutumia na uzoefu wa vitendo.
organic.nutrientsTitle: Calcium, Phosphorus, Potassium na Sulfur hai
organic.nutrientsBody: Suluhisho za virutubisho hai kwa uzalishaji wa mazao na usimamizi wa rutuba ya udongo. Kila bidhaa inaweza kuwa na mwongozo wake, vipimo na maonyesho.
organic.youtubeBody: Tutaweka hapa video za vitendo za kilimo hai ili wakulima waone mbinu, bidhaa na mawazo yakitumika badala ya kusoma tu kuzihusu.
organic.guidesBody: Chunguza miongozo na blogu yetu kwa taarifa za vitendo kuhusu afya ya udongo, pembejeo za kibayolojia, mifugo, mazao, masoko na usimamizi wa shamba wenye faida.
